name: Laser Profiling
shortDescription: Precision laser cutting up to 5000 x 1500mm in 12mm steel, 12mm stainless and 10mm aluminium.
description: Our Amada LC Alpha IV 4Kw CO2 laser provides precision laser cutting and profiling services for a wide range of materials. From simple flat profiles to complex nested components, our laser cutting service delivers clean, accurate parts ready for the next stage of manufacture.

name: Folding & Pressing
shortDescription: CNC press brakes from 100 to 220 ton capacity with folding lengths up to 4 metres, plus hydraulic presses.
description: Our press brake department handles folding and pressing operations from simple single bends to complex multi-bend components. All our CNC press brakes feature back gauge systems for consistent, repeatable accuracy.
